example.en: My father taught me how to ride a bike.

senses.en: to become the father of a child

example.en: He fathered two children before moving abroad.
example.zh: 他在移居国外前有了两个孩子。

senses.en: a person who starts or develops something important

example.en: He is often called the father of modern computing.
example.zh: 他常被称为现代计算之父。

senses.en: a title used for a priest

example.en: Father John will lead the service.

senses.en: the white liquid produced by mammals and drunk as food

example.en: She poured a glass of milk.

senses.en: to take milk from an animal

example.en: He milks the cows every morning.
example.zh: 他每天早上给奶牛挤奶。

senses.en: to get as much advantage or money as possible from something

example.en: The company milked the project for all it was worth.
example.zh: 公司把这个项目榨取到了极致。
